## 3. MODEL AUTHORIZATION LAYER

### Approved Model Classes

Primary Models:

* GPT-5 — complex reasoning, strategy, synthesis
* Gemini — multimodal processing, speed-critical inference

Secondary / Fallback Models:

* LLaMA-4 — cost optimization, redundancy

Experimental models are sandbox-only.

---

## 4. MODEL SELECTION RULES

* No automatic model switching
* Model choice defined at workflow design
* Any change requires Neon Vision approval

Model changes are logged with:

* Reason
* Impact scope
* Rollback plan

---

## 5. PROMPT GOVERNANCE

### Prompt Classification

* System Prompts (restricted)
* Task Prompts (controlled)
* User Inputs (sanitized)

Rules:

* No client data embedded in reusable prompts
* Prompts version-controlled
* Prompt drift monitored

---

## 6. DATA HANDLING & PRIVACY

### Client Data Rules

* Zero training usage
* No cross-client context leakage
* No prompt memory persistence

### Vector & Memory Isolation

* Dedicated vector space per client
* No
